environment.rustc_note: Available compiler is not asserted to be the compiler that produced the worker; executed binary SHA-256 identifies it.

storage.durability_scope: Two SQLite commits include requested WAL syncs. Hardware power-loss durability is not measured.
storage.close_checkpoint: Store close/checkpoint is outside the authorization timing.

scope.action: record_claim_authorization on a synthetic local SQLite target
scope.corpus: One synthetic evidence pair and one prepared proof B reused with fresh signed challenges and unique synthetic operation objects.
scope.worker_processes: Separate prover and verifier Rust subprocesses; the verifier receives public requests only. The Node harness itself holds the synthetic witness.
scope.timing_clock: performance.now() monotonic durations; Date.now() live authorization clock
exclusions: fixture issuance and proof preparation (reported separately)
challenge issuance and pre-verification store reads
scope.continuous_interval: From starting verify IPC through authorize return, without await between verification completion and authorize. authorize rechecks current clock/epochs inside both durable transactions.
scope.iid: Not established: sequential warm observations of one evidence pair, OS cache and storage effects. Quantile confidence intervals are conditional on IID, not service guarantees.
scope.resource_scope: process.memoryUsage() samples of the Node coordinator, including its SQLite allocations; excludes both Rust subprocesses, filesystem cache and system memory. Observed sample maximum is not a measured process peak.
